main_text.head: QVÆSTIO CV.
main_text.p: Quid flagitat Deus in sexto præcepto?
main_text.head: RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: Vt proximum neque cogitatione, neq; verbis, neque gestibus, nedum factis, vel per me, vel per alium contumelia afficiam, aut oderim, aut lædam, aut a occidam: sed omnem b vindictæ cupiditatem abijciam. Ad hæc ne meipsum lædam, aut sciens in aliquod c periculum conijciam. Quocirca etiam, ne cædes fierent, magistratum d gladio armauit.
main_text.head: QVÆSTIO CVI.
main_text.p: Atqui hoc præceptum solam cædem prohibere videtur?
main_text.head: RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: At cædem prohibendo docet Deus, se radicem & originem cædis a, iram scilicet b, inuidiam c, odium, & vindictæ cupiditatem, atque ea omnia prod cæde ducere.
a Proverb.14,30. Rom.3,29. b 1 Iohan.2,11. c Iacobi 1,20. Galat.5,19. d 1 Ioh.3,15.
main_text.head: QVÆSTIO CVII.
main_text.p: An verò id satis est, nos neminem eo, quo dictum est modo, occidere?
main_text.head: RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: Non est satis: dum enim Deus iram, inuidiam, odium damnat, postulat vt proximum æque ac nos ipsos a diligamus, & vt b humilitate, lenitate, mansuetudine c, patientia, & misericordia, erga eum vtamur, quodque ei damno esse possit, quantum in nobis est e, auertamus.

page.notes: Printed marginal letters a–e in the text are reference marks; the notes are given as footnotes. The top left corner of the page carries a faint trace of the facing page; the second line of the running head is partly smudged. The word "vtamur" and the phrase "quantum in nobis est" are slightly unclear in the scan.
